comments.author: FriedEngineer
comments.body_html:
If you have a few minutes, could you help me understand what may be going on (so I can hopefully fix it) by answering a few questions?

  • Just to confirm, the quick use keybinds set out of raid were kept and continue to function when in-raid, you were just unable to set any new ones?
  • How many (real) people were in the raid? (headless hosting you, anyone else?)
  • Did you see any errors?
    • in either your logs, in the logs of your headless client, or in the server? (that’s roughly in order of likelihood of where I’d expect them if there were any)
  • Did you add the UseItemsAnywhere.dll to the headless as well or just your client?

comments.author: Blueford
comments.body_html:
I don’t know if this problem specifically requires UIFixes as well, and maybe the ability to reload using mags from anywhere itself only manifests if you use these two mods together, but I can confirm (for versions 3.10 and/or below) having reloaded guns using mags from the backpack due to UIFixes, this mod, or maybe the combination thereof.

I don’t remember if I’ve ever loaded a gun with a mag from a nested container in those earlier versions, though. Maybe this crash was always there and I just happened to avoid the circumstance.

Anyway, I found out this was possible completely on accident by using a PPSh with drums before having a rig which could hold them, absentmindedly hitting reload and actually reloading, and then having a “wait a minute….” moment and looking in my inventory after successfully reloading like “wait, that was the mag from my backpack, those squares are empty now, what the heck?” I may or may not have been using UIFixes when that happened.
